edits.after: Un cuaderno que no has retomado en años, una clase de preguntas que siempre reabres, una manera de trabajar o una realidad que nunca puedes esquivar por completo al verla. No ocupan siempre tu agenda, pero parecen una línea inacabada que vuelve bajo formas distintas en diferentes etapas.
edits.reason: Naturalize a notebook left unfinished rather than a notebook itself being interrupted.
edits.before: Un cuaderno interrumpido hace años, una clase de preguntas que siempre reabres, una manera de trabajar o una realidad que nunca puedes esquivar por completo al verla. No ocupan siempre tu agenda, pero parecen una línea inacabada que vuelve bajo formas distintas en diferentes etapas.

edits.after: Some repetition merely goes in circles. The language of the question does not change, nor does action advance; you repeatedly gain a passing feeling without drawing closer to anything real. Other returns build on what came before. Initially there is only a vague attraction; later it calls for knowledge, then for choices, work produced, responsibility, and responses to others. The thing does not simply copy itself, but becomes more concrete with each return.
edits.reason: Naturalize returns accumulating as progressive accumulation, preserving every stage of development.
edits.before: Some repetition merely goes in circles. The language of the question does not change, nor does action advance; you repeatedly gain a passing feeling without drawing closer to anything real. Other returns accumulate. Initially there is only a vague attraction; later it calls for knowledge, then for choices, work produced, responsibility, and responses to others. The thing does not simply copy itself, but becomes more concrete with each return.

edits.after: Algunas repeticiones giran sobre sí mismas. El lenguaje de la pregunta no cambia y la acción no avanza; se obtiene una emoción pasajera sin acercarse a ninguna realidad. En otros casos, cada regreso añade algo. Primero hay una atracción vaga, luego una exigencia de conocimientos y más tarde de elecciones, obras, responsabilidades y respuestas a otros. La cosa no se copia: se vuelve más concreta con cada regreso.
edits.reason: Repair the incomplete transitive acumulan while preserving cumulative rather than circular return.
edits.before: Algunas repeticiones giran sobre sí mismas. El lenguaje de la pregunta no cambia y la acción no avanza; se obtiene una emoción pasajera sin acercarse a ninguna realidad. Otras recurrencias acumulan. Primero hay una atracción vaga, luego una exigencia de conocimientos y más tarde de elecciones, obras, responsabilidades y respuestas a otros. La cosa no se copia: se vuelve más concreta con cada regreso.

edits.after: A veces la dificultad revela que te gustaba la fantasía, no la actividad real; otras, la dirección es auténtica pero su forma actual no encaja; otras, las condiciones de vida cambiaron y el coste de continuar supera lo que estás dispuesto a asumir. Reevaluar no es deslealtad, siempre que no confundamos incomodidad momentánea con desacuerdo duradero sobre la dirección.
edits.reason: Compare the cost of continuing with what the person is willing to bear, not continuing itself with a cost.
edits.before: A veces la dificultad revela que te gustaba la fantasía, no la actividad real; otras, la dirección es auténtica pero su forma actual no encaja; otras, las condiciones de vida cambiaron y continuar supera el coste que aceptas. Reevaluar no es deslealtad, siempre que no confundamos incomodidad momentánea con desacuerdo duradero sobre la dirección.

edits.after: Many activities are directed toward others in the first place. A work needs readers, a service needs users, and public action needs shared participation. If we care nothing about whether others understand or benefit, ‘only for myself’ can sometimes be a refusal to let what we do be tested against reality.
edits.reason: Naturalize refusal of testing and make its object clear, retaining the distinction between audience response and applause.
edits.before: Many activities are directed toward others in the first place. A work needs readers, a service needs users, and public action needs shared participation. If we care nothing about whether others understand or benefit, ‘only for myself’ can sometimes be a refusal of testing.

edits.after: Muchas actividades se dirigen de entrada a otros. Las obras necesitan lectores, los servicios usuarios y la acción pública participación compartida. Si no nos importa en absoluto si otros comprenden o se benefician, «solo para mí» puede convertirse a veces en una forma de eludir que se ponga a prueba lo que hacemos.
edits.reason: Clarify testing the activity, not rejecting a proof; retain all examples and the sometimes qualification.
edits.before: Muchas actividades se dirigen de entrada a otros. Las obras necesitan lectores, los servicios usuarios y la acción pública participación compartida. Desentenderse por completo de que otros comprendan o se beneficien puede convertir «solo para mí» en rechazo de la prueba.

edits.after: What we really want to discern is only whether an activity's value is conferred entirely, moment by moment, by those watching.
edits.reason: 即时 modifies the granting of value, not the physical proximity or immediacy of the spectators.
edits.before: What we really want to discern is only whether an activity's value is granted entirely by its immediate spectators.

edits.after: You cannot yet describe ideal education, but know that ranking children only by grades is not enough. You do not know how to build better institutions, but cannot accept responsibility always falling on those without decision-making power. You have not yet created a work, but know existing language has not accommodated an experience.
edits.reason: Natural English for a work not yet created, preserving all three examples of recognizing an absence.
edits.before: You cannot yet describe ideal education, but know that ranking children only by grades is not enough. You do not know how to build better institutions, but cannot accept responsibility always falling on those without decision-making power. You have not formed a work, but know existing language has not accommodated an experience.

edits.after: Action requires dissatisfaction to answer to reality and also limits its endless expansion.
edits.reason: Naturalize bear reality as having to answer to reality, preserving the constraint imposed by action.
edits.before: Action makes dissatisfaction bear reality and also limits its endless expansion.

edits.after: La acción hace que la insatisfacción responda ante la realidad y limita su expansión infinita.

edits.before: La acción hace que la insatisfacción asuma la realidad y limita su expansión infinita.

edits.after: I may not be able to describe my ideal work immediately, yet gradually know I do not want income to measure all my time. I may not know where I ultimately want to live, yet know I do not want to spend my life maintaining respectability in others' eyes. I may not yet be able to say what I want to create, yet affirm that merely repeating familiar answers cannot continue.
edits.reason: Preserve inability to articulate a positive answer, not a voluntary choice not to describe it; retain all three negative recognitions.

review_scope.method: Read every Chinese, English and Spanish paragraph from the formal incoming ZIP, comparing meaning, argument, examples and qualifications; checked paragraph alignment against supplied Markdown. Local edits preserve paragraph positions and complete argument.
review_scope.limitations: Editorial and cross-language review, not independent empirical verification of every general claim. No site files edited or incoming scripts executed.
review_scope.truncation_recovery: All paragraph readings were bounded and untruncated; no unread text certified.
